summary.text: Katrina E. Callsen is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 54th District, which covers part of Albemarle County and the city of Charlottesville, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Callsen sits on the House committees on Finance, Courts of Justice, Privileges and Elections and General Laws.

paragraphs.text: Katrina E. Callsen was born in Schweinfurt, Germany, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Callsen's education as Yale University (B.A. Political Science, May 2008) and University of Virginia School of Law (J.D., May 2014).
The profile gives Callsen's occupation as attorney.
